pages.text: Before launching a Zephyr Hauler, you must ensure its flight path is completely unobstructed. Balloons are massive structures and require strict clearance to ascend safely into the atmosphere.

The $(item)Zephyr Dock$() is the fundamental destination block for your network. It acts as a secure landing pad to receive haulers and their cargo. Right-click an empty dock to assign it a unique name.

pages.title: Required Area
pages.text: $(2)The 3x3 Clearance:$()$(br)A hauler requires a strictly clear $(2)3x3 block area$() centered directly above the dock and extending all the way upwards. If any solid block, tree branch, or wall intercepts this column, the launch will abort.

pages.title: Required Altitude
pages.text: $(2)Altitude Requirement$() 60 Blocks$(br)The balloon must have an unobstructed vertical path upwards for a distance of at least $(2)60 blocks$() towards the sky limit. If a ceiling or mountain blocks this path, the system will trigger a $(4)Path Blocked$() warning.
